The Event

What is Senior Chef Showdown?

When

Goal: $60K for 60 Years

Join us for an evening of sizzling skill, savory bites, and senior support as chefs from Central Florida's top senior living communities battle for the coveted Senior Cup. Each dish incorporates this year's common ingredient — honey — in celebration of the event's Birthday theme. Guests taste, vote, and make a difference, all in one spectacular night.

This year's event, Senior Chef Showdown 2026 Presented by Village on the Green, is a milestone celebration honoring Seniors First's 60th anniversary. Our goal is to raise $60,000 — a dollar for every year Seniors First has served Central Florida's senior community.

Our Beneficiary

Supporting Seniors First, Inc.

60 Years
Serving Central FL

60 Years of Changing Lives

Founded in 1966, Seniors First is the largest social services organization in metro Orlando, dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for seniors through Meals on Wheels, in-home care, medical equipment, and community programs. Net proceeds from Senior Chef Showdown go directly to Seniors First.
